annotations.title: Add a screen to an app

description: Needs a subscription. Adds one screen designed in the App Builder to a project. With the project's .opointo/files.json it returns the screen file, the route that mounts it and the one line to register it, and never rewrites existing files. Without it, a self-contained screen file for any Expo app.

appId.description: the share code from "Send app to agent"

screen.description: the new screen's name in that design

tab.description: nest it in this tab's stack; omit for the root, which covers the tab bar
